paper.title: Hydrogen storage capacity of carbon nanotubes, filaments, and vapor-grown fibers

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Table 1 + apparatus): 11 carbon rows; metal standards (LaNi5/La0.93Ni5/Nd2Fe14B) correctly excluded. Two-column placement verified -- PCI point values at 3.59 MPa/35.9 bar, high-pressure-manual upper limits at 11 MPa/110 bar (<0.7/<0.5/<0.2 -> uptake_bound=upper). All PCI magnitudes confirmed; T=23 C/296 K; uptake_type=unspecified; surface_area_method=none (the ~700 m2/g for Norit is nominal, not measured here). Calibration earned (He void-volume + Van der Waals non-ideality + empty-chamber PCI background subtraction + LaNi5/Nd2Fe14B standard verification) -> all 11 Tier B. Agent C: M1/M2 uncertainty_wt_pct added (0.011/0.014, the Table 1 +/- values); M3/M4 synthesis_method arc_discharge/laser_ablation->commercial (the paper names only the supplier, not the growth route); M11 (FeNiCu) activation_method cleared (it described the CVD growth, not an activation treatment). material_class MWCNT (MER)/SWCNT (Rice)/carbon_nanofiber (VGCF, filaments)/other (graphite) confirmed.

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper says 'hydrogen sorption/storage capacity'; neither 'excess' nor 'total' is used
notes.cond: all capacities are at 23 C (296 K); the PCI (Gas Reaction Controller) values are at 3.59 MPa (=35.9 bar); the high-pressure manual-system values are UPPER LIMITS at 11 MPa (=110 bar), from pressure drops not unambiguous sorption
notes.upper: the manual-system values are reported as '<x' upper limits (not clear sorption events), so uptake_bound=upper
notes.sa: surface_area_method=none: the paper tabulates no surface area; it mentions only an approximate ~700 m2/g for the Norit Darco AC and that the VGCF are ~70x lower, which are asides, not a characterization table
notes.method: both devices are volumetric (a manual high-pressure sorption apparatus to 11 MPa and a Gas Reaction Controller PCI to ~4 MPa); empty-chamber PCI subtraction, He leak/volume calibration, temperature-drift correction and LaNi5/Nd2Fe14B reference checks -> measurement_method=volumetric_sieverts, calibration point by hand
notes.excl: the LaNi5 / La0.93Ni5 and Nd2Fe14B samples are metal hydrides used for calibration, not carbon, and are excluded
notes.vgcf: vapor-grown carbon fibre / catalytic carbon filament -> class=carbon_nanofiber, synthesis_method=cvd (HYC-0004 CNF precedent); etch/graphitization treatments noted in activation_method
notes.graphite: flake graphite is non-porous graphite -> class=other (HYC-0004-S1 precedent)
notes.nullvalue: a deliberately-recorded near-zero/upper-bound result: the paper's thesis is that carbon H2 sorption at room temperature is <~0.1 wt%, so these are genuine low-uptake data (bias guard)

S1.label: Graphite flakes
S1.material_description: flake graphite (Johnson Matthey), average flake size a few microns

S2.label: Norit Darco AC
S2.material_description: Norit Darco activated carbon G-60 (wood-based), ~700 m2/g

S3.label: MER nanotubes
S3.material_description: carbon nanotubes from MER Corporation (ball-milled; assessed as multi-walled despite a nominal 10-15% SWNT spec)

S4.label: Rice nanotubes
S4.material_description: single-walled carbon nanotube bundles from Tubes@Rice (~14 nm bundle diameter)

S5.label: Graphitized PYROGRAF
S5.material_description: PYROGRAF vapor-grown carbon fibre (Applied Sciences), heat-treated to 3000 C to graphitize

S6.label: Air-etched PYROGRAF
S6.material_description: PYROGRAF vapor-grown carbon fibre, air-etched at 450 C for 15 min (opens fibre ends)

S7.label: CO2-etched PYROGRAF
S7.material_description: PYROGRAF vapor-grown carbon fibre, CO2-etched at 950 C for 15 min (removes the CVD layer, exposes the herringbone core)

S8.label: Showa Denko VGCF
S8.material_description: vapor-grown carbon fibre from Showa Denko KK (~200 nm diameter, graphitized)

S9.label: FeNiCu filaments
S9.material_description: carbon filaments grown from a Fe:Ni:Cu 85:10:5 catalyst in ethylene at 600 C (herringbone structure)
